frequency_question: How often do states successfully establish domestic licensed production of complex foreign precision guided missiles within a 3 to 4 year window of initiation?
membership_rule: Includes state-level defense industrial programs attempting to localize complex foreign cruise missile or equivalent high-end guided weapon manufacturing during wartime or active emergency acquisition cycles. Excludes routine peacetime domestic production transfers and low-tech munitions like basic artillery or unguided rockets.

cases.name: UK-France transfer of Exocet/Apache technology variants (historical analogs)
Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile domestic scaling programs
Pakistan Babur cruise missile localization via technology transfer
South Korea Taurus/cruise missile domestic production initiatives

coverage_note: 4 named; represents the complete set of major comparable rapid-transfer high-end missile localization attempts by secondary defense powers.
known_gaps: Classified or highly obscured domestic weapon programs in smaller nations may be under-reported.
skeleton: 4 named historical analog programs for high-tech domestic missile localization under urgent/wartime defense constraints
validity_reason: Defense industrial base transfer timelines and technological absorption rates change slowly over decades.
